svg.title: South Cariboo Community Health Council — one shared tree master
svg.desc: The visible dark tree is the original SVG master. The pale tree is a linked use of exactly that geometry at five-sixths scale. Edit the master to update both. No independent pale shapes or raster images.
svg.metadata: {"revision": "shared-master-soft-crown-v2", "status": "User-authorized reconstruction assumption: exactly one reused tree drawing.", "method": "One authored dark master and a linked SVG use instance, uniform five-sixths scale and translation only. No pale completion, omitted openings or independent flecks. No tracing or raster contour extraction.", "landmark_rms_px": 0.39729341415755354, "connectivity": "One main connected body, including the restored narrow lower twig bridge, plus eight deliberate detached brush flecks reused identically in both instances.", "source_limit": "Strict reuse leaves pale-right gaps where the source appears more solid. The identical whole-tree construction is an explicit assumption, not verified historical provenance.", "typeface": "ITC Souvenir Demi reconstruction outlines retained; historical cut/vendor unverified.", "colours": "Sampled RGB #417A3A and #9BBC95; not official print specifications.", "bridge_revision": "Source-supported authored join from lower twig to main branch at approximately x39\u201342,y124\u2013128.", "crown_cleanup": "Rounded the apex and softened abrupt crown shoulders while preserving the overall lean, height and shared-master relationship."}
